Bash(lua -e "
package.path = ''libs/?.lua;?.lua;'' .. package.path
local _Rampant_prefix = ''''
data = { extend = function\(self, x\) end }
local function transformPairs\(settingPairs\)
    local a = {}
    for _, setting in pairs\(settingPairs\) do
        local settingType = setting.setting_type
        if settingType == ''runtime-global'' then settingType = ''global'' end
        if not a[settingType] then a[settingType] = {} end
        a[settingType][setting.name] = { [''value''] = setting.default_value }
    end
    return a
end
local rampantSettings = require\(''settings''\)
settings = transformPairs\(rampantSettings\)
package.preload[''__Rampant__/Constants''] = function\(\) return require\(''Constants''\) end
package.preload[''__Rampant__/libs/MathUtils''] = function\(\) return require\(''libs/MathUtils''\) end
package.preload[''__Rampant__/libs/Utils''] = function\(\) return require\(''libs/Utils''\) end
package.preload[''__Rampant__/libs/MapUtils''] = function\(\) return require\(''libs/MapUtils''\) end

function refreshingRequire\(path\)
    package.loaded[path] = nil
    return require\(path\)
end

local c = \(\(2 ^ 32\) - 1\)
bit32 = {}
bit32[''bxor''] = function\(x, y\) return \(x ~ y\) & c end
bit32[''lshift''] = function\(x, y\) return \(x << y\) & c end
bit32[''rshift''] = function\(x, y\) return \(x >> y\) & c end

defines = {}
defines.events = { on_tick = ''on_tick'' }

script = { on_event = function\(\) end }
remote = { add_interface = function\(\) end }
commands = { add_command = function\(\) end }
game = { tick = 0, active_mods = {}, create_random_generator = function\(seed\) return require\(''libs/MathUtils''\).xorRandom\(seed\) end }
global = {}

local Fixtures = require\(''tests/fixtures''\)
local Universe = Fixtures.makeUniverse\(\)
local MapUtils = refreshingRequire\(''libs/MapUtils''\)
MapUtils.init\(Universe\)

local surface = Fixtures.makeSurface\(''test''\)
local map = Fixtures.makeMap\(surface\)
map.universe = Universe

-- Test: chunk with id
local chunk = Fixtures.makeChunk\(map, 0, 0\)
print\(''Chunk id:'', chunk.id\)
print\(''Chunk x:'', chunk.x\)
print\(''Chunk y:'', chunk.y\)

-- Register chunk
Fixtures.registerChunk\(map, chunk\)
print\(''Chunk registered''\)

-- Test victoryScent
local success, err = pcall\(function\(\)
    MapUtils.victoryScent\(chunk, ''wall''\)
end\)
if not success then
    print\(''Error:'', err\)
else
    print\(''Victory scent result:'', chunk.victoryGenerator\)
end
")
